text:
tammy_ops: prod-usw4 warm-pool failing to join after egress tighten + HSM proxy endpoint rename. nodes stuck in JOIN_PENDING, kubelet TLS to hsm-proxy.usw4.internal:443 resets
oscar_sre: confirmed. warm-pool backlog ~48 pods, allocator showing 30-60s scheduling delays
deploy-bot: change CHG-2026-0701-EG applied at 2026-07-01T07:40Z -> egress default-deny with allowlist generated
fw-team: policy generator expanded FQDNs but pruned hostnames with '.' in subdomain during IP expansion. new hsm-proxy name hsm.proxy-02.usw4.internal got dropped
tammy_ops: repro from node: curl -v https://hsm.proxy-02.usw4.internal:443 -> TCP reset, kubelet logs: "tls: handshake failure" and join backoff
audit-bot: auditshipper PutObject retries to s3://redwood-audit-prod spiked 2.3x between 07:40-07:58. estimated incremental S3 cost ~$790
finance: tagging BILL-2026-0701-HSM for chargeback, please add exact byte counts
fw-team: hotfix applied: added explicit allow for hsm.proxy-02.* and keystore.usw4.internal at 07:52Z. warm-pool recovered +26 nodes by 08:00
oscar_sre: impact estimate: ~85 node-minutes delayed capacity, several jobs backfilled to lower-tier pools, minor customer latency blips
tammy_ops: action items: 1) patch FQDN expansion logic to preserve subdomains with dots (fw-team) 2) add FQDN whitelist smoke test to egress validator (oscar) 3) auditshipper backpressure circuit (tammy) 4) update egress runbook to require keystore/KMS/HSM handshake checks (tammy)
fw-team: will add unit tests and run generator against live inventory in staging. pausing further default-deny rollouts in prod-usw4 until validated
tammy_ops: postmortem kickoff in ops/incidents, will close after patch, validator job green, and auditshipper PR merged :thumbsup:
